sources.title: Entry visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Foreign Ministry guidance on its official fm.gov.om domain identifies ROP as the authority and links its visa-eligibility wizard.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of other nationalities can establish their visa options via the ROP’s eVisa website.

sources.title: Visa-Free Entry Countries
sources.officialityEvidence: The live ROP nationality list is published on the official rop.gov.om domain; its first list labels named countries as enterable without a tourist visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List No. (1): Countries that can be entered without a tourist visa

sources.title: Visa Eligibility Wizard - Unsponsored Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The ROP eVisa portal is linked by the Foreign Ministry. Fresh sessioned POST replays selected each scoped nationality and non-GCC residence response before reading the returned product conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Your answers will determine which visa types are available to you.

conflicts.explanation: ROP’s current static List No. (1) says Taiwan can enter without a tourist visa, but a fresh Taiwan/non-GCC wizard session exposes paid G1 tourist products 26A, 26B and 36B, and the Foreign Ministry’s groups omit Taiwan. The sources do not reconcile those outcomes.
